bug_info.bug_desc: In the StError state, when lc_en_i becomes valid ON, the FSM transitions directly to StActive. This causes err_en to be deasserted before any already-accepted error responses have been drained. If outstanding_txn is nonzero, the locally generated TL-UL error response that is still pending can be dropped or blocked, violating the re-enabling transition requirement that outstanding error responses must be delivered before resuming forwarding.
bug_info.fix_hint: Change the StError exit on lc_en_i ON to transition to the error-outstanding/drain state instead of StActive. In that drain state, keep err_en asserted and block new requests until outstanding_txn reaches zero, then transition to StActive only after all pending error responses have been delivered.
